events.title: New Client Opportunity
events.description: A bakery chain's payment terminals went down an hour before the morning rush. They found your name on DarkNode and want someone right now.

choices.label: Refer them to someone else
choices.description: You stay rested, and the board remembers the favour.

events.title: Hardware Malfunction
events.description: Your machine reboots twice in ten minutes. Something inside smells warm.

choices.label: Tape it up and carry on
choices.description: It will hold. You will miss a deadline finding out.

events.title: An Anonymous Offer
events.description: A message with no sender offers good money to 'look over' a training range without telling its owner you were asked.

choices.label: Tell the range owner
choices.description: No pay. They will remember who warned them.

events.title: Power Cut
events.description: The whole block goes dark. Your screens die mid-sentence.

choices.label: Buy a battery backup
choices.description: It keeps everything running until the power returns.

choices.label: Wait in the dark
choices.description: You lose the afternoon, and whatever was not saved.

events.title: Resignation Letter
events.description: {employee} asks for a word. Another firm has offered more money, and they wanted you to hear it from them first.

events.title: Competitor Recruitment
events.description: A rival firm has been messaging your whole team with job adverts. People are talking about it at lunch.

choices.label: Take everyone out to dinner
choices.description: Remind them why they work here.

events.title: Server Failure
events.description: An alarm at three in the morning: a disk array has dropped out and services are running without a spare.

choices.label: Pay for emergency replacement
choices.description: A courier, a new array, no downtime.

choices.label: Run without a spare until Monday

events.title: Research Breakthrough
events.description: A result nobody expected: one experiment makes three others unnecessary.

choices.label: Publish it
choices.description: Share the method. Slower for you, good for your name.

events.title: A Glowing Review
events.description: A widely read newsletter calls your software 'the tool I did not know I needed'.

choices.label: Pay to promote the review
choices.description: Put it in front of more people.
